headline: PBOC and Regulators to Meet on Measures to Arrest China Stock Slide
summary: China’s central bank and securities regulators are set to meet with financial institutions to discuss measures to bolster the domestic stock market following an October sell-off.
why: Interventions and coordinated meetings by China's central bank and regulators signal policy efforts to restore investor confidence and stabilize domestic equity markets.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Regulatory meetings and support measures are aimed at arresting the stock slide and supporting Chinese equities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcements of high-level regulatory intervention aimed at shoring up market stability typically trigger short-term buying interest and curb panic selling.
